title: Oura Ring category reel
description: A horizontal reel of tall photo cards running off the right edge: each card has a frosted icon chip top-left, a cream plus button top-right and a light 40px grotesk line over a dark fade at the bottom. Under it a hairline and a bare left arrow beside a dark round right arrow. While the page scrolls the photo inside each card drifts slower than the page (scrubbed parallax); hovering a card zooms its photo a touch.
notes: cards are 493×626 on desktop and 312×317 on phones (80% of the screen, the next one peeks in)
the parallax reads a view timeline named on the section, because the track itself is a horizontal scroll container
the arrows need JavaScript (hydrate visible); swiping and the scroll-snap work without it
photo slots are empty warm-ink panels until filled; the cards are dark-scoped so their type stays cream
